title: Codex card definitions
description: What each Codex card says. The per-profile STATE of a card — learnedAt and pvpLegalAt — already exists as CodexCardStateSchema in packages/contracts/src/progression.ts; the definitions did not exist anywhere, which is the gap this file closes. `cardId` and `conceptId` are the two fields that join the two, and both spellings are consumed from surfaces that already use them rather than minted here.

conceptId.description: Exactly one concept per card. CodexCardStateSchema.conceptId is a single id, and per-concept mastery is what mints PvP legality.

proposition.description: What the student must be able to state. One card is one proposition; if it needs an 'and' between two unrelated claims it is two cards.

sourceCueId.description: The module card that teaches this. Exactly one, so 'learned' is a fact about the deck rather than a judgement about the student.
